newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Q2 comm'l, personal lines gained.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Q2 comm'l, personal lines gained.

text.p: Travelers Property Casualty Corp said Tuesday operating earnings for its commercial lines rose 17 percent during the second quarter ended June 30 to $209.3 million from $178.3 million for the year-ago quarter.
It said operating earnings for personal lines grew 57 percent to $101.3 million in the latest quarter, up from $64.7 million, a year ago.
Net written premiums for the latest quarter were $1.886 billion compared to $1.776 billion for the corresponding quarter in 1996, excluding adjustment associated with a reinsurance transaction.

It said the statutory combined ratio for the quarter was 103.0 percent, an improvement from 107.2 percent in the 1996 quarter, excluding charges associated with the acquisition and integration of the Aetna propertry casualty businesses.
